verdict.rationale: Assigning conversations and rule-based routing are fair questions for an email platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent features: Labels as string tags for tracking conversation state, Lists for allow/block filtering of senders, and webhook/pod routing for multi-tenancy. None of these documents assigning a thread to a teammate or routing incoming mail to an owner by rule.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
